data.why: The old road layout: a dirt strip across the cut, rebuilt in layers; the rain's path into the stone, through the drain pipe and out, then the cars on the finished road. The camera follows the car, then the water down through the layers, then the road surface.

chain.shows: rain turns the dirt to mud and the car is stuck
cars kick up the loose stone as dust
the black road disappears at night

surprises.claim: A road's crushed stone base spreads the load of the cars and lets water drain.
surprises.search: road crushed stone base course spreads load drainage

surprises.claim: Water trapped in a road's base weakens it.
surprises.search: water trapped in pavement base weakens road

surprises.claim: Asphalt binds the stone together and seals the road surface.
surprises.search: asphalt binder holds aggregate together seals road surface

surprises.claim: Painted road lines contain glass beads that reflect headlights at night.
surprises.search: road marking paint glass beads retroreflect headlights at night

ideas.idea: a car drives along the dirt strip
rain falls, mud splashes and the car's wheels spin in the mud
the strip is dug out and crushed stone pours in
water rises inside the stone layer
a holed pipe grows under the stone and the water drains out
a car drives over the loose stone and dust clouds up
a black asphalt layer covers the stone
a paved road is built in layers
night falls on the dark road
white center lines appear on the road
a speeding taxi crashes at the corner
a stop line and a stop sign appear at the corner
the leaf washes out of the drain and the road lies smooth

sentences.text: If you drive the same strip of dirt daily, you have a road.
But rain turns it to mud, and the wheels spin.
So you dig it out and pack in stone.
But rain soaks into the stone and sits there.
So a holed pipe under the stone carries it away.
But cars kick the stone into dust.
So you seal the top with asphalt.
But black asphalt is hard to see at night.
So you paint white lines down it.
But cars speed along the lines and crash at the corner.
So you add a stop line and sign.
Now drive that strip daily, smooth and dry.
Congratulations, you have built a road.
